decision_conditions:
<p><span style="line-height: 107%;">The proposed development, in the absence of a Legal Agreement to provide
appropriate public benefits, monitoring and mitigation that directly relate to
the development, would fail to adequately ameliorate the impact of the
development on the application site and wider area or provide for necessary
wider public socio economic public benefits, environmental and infrastructural
improvements arising directly from the development. The proposal is therefore
contrary to the National Planning Policy Framework (2024), policies H4, H5, E11,
G6, G7, S I2, T4 and DF1 of The London Plan (2021), Policies H04, Strategic
Policy (03, 04,) GI3, GI4, CN1, CN2 and M1 of the Harrow Local Plan (2021-2041) and the Supplementary Planning Document: Planning
Obligations (2013).</span></p>

<p class="MsoNormal">The proposed development has failed to demonstrate that it
would deliver the maximum reasonable amount of affordable housing and, as such,
would not adequately support the creation of mixed and balanced communities. In
the absence of affordable housing provision, the public benefits
arising from the scheme are insufficient to outweigh the identified
harm to the site’s ecological and biodiversity value. Furthermore, given the
Council’s confirmed five-year housing land supply, the overall benefits of the
proposal are not considered to outweigh the adverse impacts identified. The
proposal is therefore contrary to the National Planning Policy Framework (2024),
Policies H4, H5, G1, G6 and G7 of the London Plan, Policies &nbsp;HO4, GI3 and GI4 of the Harrow Local Plan (2021 to 2041), the
Mayor of London Affordable Housing and Viability SPG (2017), the London Plan
Guidance: Support for Housebuilding (March 2026), and Harrow’s Supplementary
Planning Document: Planning Obligations and Affordable Housing (2013).<o:p></o:p></p>
